_comment: Experiment 43, arm B, d = 5: Zhang, Hou, Fang, Hu, Deng, arXiv:2004.11289 (2020), Sec. II, taken literally: L = 4..60, 1e6 samples for L <= 20 and 1e5 for L = 24..60 (the stated minima, 'more than 10^6' and 'at least 10^5'). Our model and observable (site, face_far, cylinder), not theirs (bond, largest cluster, periodic). About 1.2e14 cost units, ~9 GPU-hours per replicate.
source: Zhang et al. 2020, arXiv:2004.11289, Sec. II (5D)
